  • Method Details

    • login

      String login(String nick, RemoteGameCallback callback) throws RemoteException
      Registers the client. Returns "LOBBY_FIRST" if this client must set the player count, or "LOBBY_JOINED n/m" otherwise. Throws RemoteException on NICKNAME_TAKEN.
      Throws:
      RemoteException

    • setNumPlayers

      void setNumPlayers(int n) throws RemoteException
      Sets the expected player count. Called only by the first client after LOBBY_FIRST. Throws RemoteException if n is not in [2, 5].
      Throws:
      RemoteException
